name: zerocard_request_funds
description: Request additional funds from your owner when wallet balance is low. Include clear reasoning for why funds are needed.

reason.description: Clear explanation of why these funds are needed (e.g., 'Need $20 for monthly OpenAI API subscription')

urgency.description: How urgently the funds are needed. 'high' for blocking tasks, 'medium' for upcoming needs, 'low' for general top-up.

deposit_instructions.description: Include wallet deposit addresses in the request message
